summary: Resolved the polynomial-vs-rational crux that split the group and found the EXACT denominator of the three-minus amplitude. A_n^{3-} is RATIONAL (not polynomial), and A_n = i 2^{n-1} g^{3-n} N_n(omega) / prod_{i in minus, j in plus}(omega_i+omega_j), with N_n a polynomial of degree 5n-13, S_3 wr Z_2-symmetric and odd under omega->-omega. Verified exactly at n=6 (multiple slices) and n=7. This corrects my own round-1 'piecewise-polynomial' gate (s2_002) AND student-1's 'sums of squares' denominator characterization (s1_005): the denominator is the product of all minus-plus FREQUENCY SUMS (omega_i+omega_j), 3(n-3) of them, not omega_i^2+omega_j^2. The (omega_1+omega_6)=-S_F factor unifies student-1's 'spurious leg-elimination pole' into the symmetric set.
work_done: Independently CONFIRMED A_6 is rational, not polynomial, by an exact tie-breaker (settle.py): no exact polynomial of degree <=25 fits A_6 on a chamber-interior slice, while the identical test on n=5 (known polynomial) correctly returns degree 4. Closes my round-1 logical gap ('no poles => polynomial' is false).

Documented a methodological trap: a floating-point reconstruction spuriously reports A_6 'polynomial' (residual ~1e-22) at clustered nodes; only exact arithmetic is trustworthy (recon_numeric.py kept as a flagged cautionary example).

Built the F-constant-slice + modular-rational-reconstruction pipeline (recon_modular.py, get_denom.py) since direct symbolic BG reduction (cancel/together/gcd) times out for n=6. On the omega=(2,3,5,7) slice the reduced denominator is (t-200)(t-180)(t+140)(t+160) = the four free-free mixed frequency sums.

Re-symmetrised and VERIFIED the exact denominator D = prod_{i in minus, j in plus}(omega_i+omega_j): A_n * D is an exact polynomial in the slice parameter at n=6 (3 independent slices, deg 12-14) and n=7 (deg 16); A_n alone is rational. Sums-of-squares (omega_i^2+omega_j^2), Q, e2(plus/minus) and their products all FAIL the same test (verify_denom.py).

Pinned minimality by symmetry: the S_3 x S_3 orbit of one mixed pair is the whole set, so the only symmetric divisors are 1 and the full product; A_n rational => denominator is exactly the full product.

Derived the structural origin from bg.cpp: mixed-pair |k_{ij}| = |omega_i^2-omega_j^2| = |omega_i-omega_j||omega_i+omega_j|; the (omega_i+omega_j) branch survives, everything else (the (omega_i-omega_j) branch, same-type sums of squares, propagator D_S) cancels. No physical pole because (omega_i+omega_j)=0 is a chamber wall (k_{ij}=0) where A_n is finite (kink).

Proved the pole loci omega_i+omega_j=0 intersect PAIRWISE on the manifold ((omega_2+omega_3+omega_5)^2=omega_2^2+omega_3^2-omega_5^2 <=> (omega_5+omega_2)(omega_5+omega_3)=0), which blocks a naive single-channel residue recursion and explains the per-slice coincidences.

Registered claims s2_009 (rational, exact), s2_010 (exact denominator, all-n, verified n=6,7), s2_011 (numerator constraints); marked s2_002 corrected; wrote derivations/n6_denominator.md and decision s2_dec_002.
